items.headline: EU forms a diplomatic team for Ukraine talks while expanding spy powers to counter Russian and Iranian threats

items.summary: Experts stress that understanding a house's specific heating demand is essential to size a heat‑pump correctly and avoid costly inefficiencies. Proper assessment can prevent oversized units that waste electricity or undersized ones that fail to keep rooms comfortable during winter.

items.headline: Real‑estate listings using AI‑enhanced photos risk misleading buyers, regulators warn
items.summary: Industry specialists say the growing practice of digitally augmenting property images can cross the line from helpful staging to deceptive advertising, especially when changes hide flaws or exaggerate space. Consumer‑protection groups are calling for clearer disclosure rules to keep buyers informed about what they are actually seeing.
